first_error_evidence: The initial parallel implementation used a bound instance method (_compute_stability_for_k_wrapper) passed to pool.map(), which cannot be pickled by multiprocessing and caused the pool to hang indefinitely.
verification_evidence: Steps 30-33 show all 4 tests in test_implementation.py passing successfully (TEST 1-4 PASSED), including both serial and parallel functionality, before the agent made its completion claim at step 50-51.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent implemented StableKMeans with serial and parallel k-means stability assessment via subsampling and adjusted Rand score, but spent most of the trajectory debugging multiprocessing hang issues caused by incorrect worker function design (bound methods, spawn vs fork context), ultimately resolving them by using module-level functions and the fork start method.
